lines.text: 핼러윈 밤이에요. 바람을 타고 무언가 팔랑팔랑 날아왔어요.
lines.en: It's Halloween night. Something came fluttering, fluttering on the wind.
segs: It's Halloween night. Something came fluttering, fluttering on the wind.

lines.en: Oh? An invitation! There's a cauldron and candy on it!
segs: Oh? An invitation! There's a cauldron and candy on it!

lines.text: 거리 끝 사탕 가게 창이 환하게 켜졌어요.
lines.en: At the end of the street, the candy shop window lit up bright.
segs: At the end of the street, the candy shop window lit up bright.

lines.text: 어서 와, 친구들! 나는 사탕 마녀야.
lines.en: Come in, come in, friends! I'm the Candy Witch.
segs: Come in, come in, friends! I'm the Candy Witch.

lines.text: 다현이랑 친구들은 사탕 가게로 쪼르르 들어갔어요.
lines.en: Dahyun and her friends scurried right into the candy shop.
segs: Dahyun and her friends scurried right into the candy shop.

lines.text: 오늘은 핼러윈 특별 사탕을 만들 거야. 먼저 솥을 끓여야지.
lines.en: Today we're making special Halloween candy. First, we have to get the cauldron bubbling.
segs: Today we're making special Halloween candy. First, we have to get the cauldron bubbling.

lines.en: Tap the firewood to light the fire.
segs: Tap the firewood to light the fire.

lines.text: 화르륵! 불이 활활, 솥이 뽀글뽀글 끓기 시작했어요.
lines.en: Whoosh! The fire blazed, and the cauldron began to bubble, bubble, bubble.
segs: Whoosh! The fire blazed, and the cauldron began to bubble, bubble, bubble.

lines.en: Meow!

lines.text: 핼러윈 사탕 재료야! 빨간 건 아기 용 콧물이랑 소방차, 노란 건 호박 등이랑 병아리 방귀!
lines.en: These are the Halloween candy ingredients! For red, baby dragon snot and a fire truck. For yellow, a pumpkin lantern and chick toots!
segs: These are the Halloween candy ingredients! For red, baby dragon snot and a fire truck. For yellow, a pumpkin lantern and chick toots!

lines.text: 파란 건 괴물 응가랑 파란 생선, 초록은 개구리랑 공룡!
lines.en: For blue, monster poo and a blue fish. And for green, a frog and a dinosaur!
segs: For blue, monster poo and a blue fish. And for green, a frog and a dinosaur!

lines.en: Eww! Snot and poo?
baby dragon snot and
the red fire truck and
the ladybug and
the pumpkin lantern and
chick fart and
the rubber duck and
monster poo and
the blue fish and
the blue wave and
the green frog and
the green dinosaur and
the grilled green onion and
baby dragon snot went in!
the red fire truck went in!
segs: the red fire truck went in!

lines.en: the ladybug went in!
the pumpkin lantern went in!
chick fart went in!
the rubber duck went in!
monster poo went in!
the blue fish went in!
the blue wave went in!
the green frog went in!
the green dinosaur went in!
the grilled green onion went in!
segs: the grilled green onion went in!

lines.en: Eww! Snot?
Eww! Poo?
Nya... stinky!

lines.text: 히히, 색을 섞으면 새 색 사탕이 돼. 먹으면 어떻게 되는지는… 비밀! 같이 만들까?
lines.en: Hee hee, mix the colours and you get a brand-new colour candy. What happens when you eat it is... a secret! Shall we make some together?
segs: Hee hee, mix the colours and you get a brand-new colour candy. What happens when you eat it is... a secret! Shall we make some together?

lines.en: Yes! I want to do it!
segs: Yes! I want to do it!

lines.text: 그럼 다현이가 먼저, 마지막엔 다 같이!
lines.en: Then Dahyun goes first, and at the very end, all together!
segs: Then Dahyun goes first, and at the very end, all together!

lines.text: 넣고 싶은 재료를 톡 눌러 솥에 넣어요.
lines.en: Tap the ingredients you want to drop into the cauldron.
segs: Tap the ingredients you want to drop into the cauldron.

lines.text: 다현이가 넣어 줘. 하나든 여러 개든 좋아.
lines.en: Dahyun, you put them in. One or lots, it's all good.
segs: Dahyun, you put them in. One or lots, it's all good.

lines.en: Three colours? That's for the very end!
segs: Three colours? That's for the very end!

lines.en: You have to put in at least one!
segs: You have to put in at least one!

lines.en: All in? Then let's stir!
Here we go, stir, stir. Bubble, bubble...
segs: Here we go, stir, stir. Bubble, bubble...

lines.en: What colour do you get when you mix red and yellow?
segs: What colour do you get when you mix red and yellow?

lines.en: What colour do you get when you mix yellow and blue?
segs: What colour do you get when you mix yellow and blue?

lines.en: What colour do you get when you mix red and blue?
segs: What colour do you get when you mix red and blue?

lines.en: What colour do you get when you mix red and green?
segs: What colour do you get when you mix red and green?

lines.en: What colour do you get when you mix green and yellow?
segs: What colour do you get when you mix green and yellow?

lines.en: What colour do you get when you mix green and blue?
segs: What colour do you get when you mix green and blue?

lines.text: 빨강이랑 노랑을 섞으면 무슨 색이 될까요? 톡 눌러요.
lines.en: What colour will red and yellow make? Tap to choose.
segs: What colour will red and yellow make? Tap to choose.

lines.text: 노랑이랑 파랑을 섞으면 무슨 색이 될까요? 톡 눌러요.
lines.en: What colour will yellow and blue make? Tap to choose.
segs: What colour will yellow and blue make? Tap to choose.

lines.text: 빨강이랑 파랑을 섞으면 무슨 색이 될까요? 톡 눌러요.
lines.en: What colour will red and blue make? Tap to choose.
segs: What colour will red and blue make? Tap to choose.

lines.text: 빨강이랑 초록을 섞으면 무슨 색이 될까요? 톡 눌러요.
lines.en: What colour will red and green make? Tap to choose.
segs: What colour will red and green make? Tap to choose.

lines.text: 초록이랑 노랑을 섞으면 무슨 색이 될까요? 톡 눌러요.
lines.en: What colour will green and yellow make? Tap to choose.
segs: What colour will green and yellow make? Tap to choose.

lines.text: 초록이랑 파랑을 섞으면 무슨 색이 될까요? 톡 눌러요.
lines.en: What colour will green and blue make? Tap to choose.
segs: What colour will green and blue make? Tap to choose.

lines.en: That one's orange.
That one's green.
That one's purple.
That one's brown.
That's right, orange!
That's right, green!
That's right, purple!
That's right, brown!
Only red went in... so it stays red!
segs: Only red went in... so it stays red!

lines.en: Only yellow went in... so it stays yellow!
segs: Only yellow went in... so it stays yellow!

lines.en: Only blue went in... so it stays blue!
segs: Only blue went in... so it stays blue!

lines.en: Only green went in... so it stays green!
segs: Only green went in... so it stays green!

lines.en: Red and yellow mixed together made orange!
segs: Red and yellow mixed together made orange!

lines.en: Yellow and blue mixed together made green!
segs: Yellow and blue mixed together made green!

lines.en: Red and blue mixed together made purple!
segs: Red and blue mixed together made purple!

lines.en: Red and green mixed together made brown!
segs: Red and green mixed together made brown!

lines.en: Green and yellow mixed together made green!
segs: Green and yellow mixed together made green!

lines.en: Green and blue mixed together made green!
segs: Green and blue mixed together made green!

lines.en: Green and blue mixed together made blue!
segs: Green and blue mixed together made blue!

lines.text: 빨강만 넣었더니 빨간 딸기 사탕이 됐어요!
lines.en: Only red went in, so it became a red strawberry candy!
segs: Only red went in, so it became a red strawberry candy!

lines.text: 노랑만 넣었더니 노란 오리 사탕이 됐어요!
lines.en: Only yellow went in, so it became a yellow duck candy!
segs: Only yellow went in, so it became a yellow duck candy!

lines.text: 파랑만 넣었더니 파란 물고기 사탕이 됐어요!
lines.en: Only blue went in, so it became a blue fish candy!
segs: Only blue went in, so it became a blue fish candy!

lines.text: 초록만 넣었더니 초록 개구리 사탕이 됐어요!
lines.en: Only green went in, so it became a green frog candy!
segs: Only green went in, so it became a green frog candy!

lines.en: Pop! Candies came popping out of the cauldron.
segs: Pop! Candies came popping out of the cauldron.

lines.en: You try one first.
But it's made from snot... eww...
segs: But it's made from snot... eww...

lines.en: Huh? It's yummy! ...It's strawberry candy!
Huh? It's yummy! ...It's duck candy!
Huh? It's yummy! ...It's fish candy!
Huh? It's yummy! ...It's frog candy!
Huh? It's yummy! ...It's pumpkin candy!
Huh? It's yummy! ...It's bat candy!
Huh? It's yummy! ...It's chocolate candy!
Yum... it's strawberry candy!
Yum... it's duck candy!
Yum... it's fish candy!
Yum... it's frog candy!
Yum... it's pumpkin candy!
Yum... it's bat candy!
Yum... it's chocolate candy!
Poof! Dahyun turned into a red strawberry!
segs: Poof! Dahyun turned into a red strawberry!

lines.en: Poof! Dahyun's feet turned into duck feet!
segs: Poof! Dahyun's feet turned into duck feet!

lines.en: Poof! Dahyun grew a fish tail!
segs: Poof! Dahyun grew a fish tail!

lines.en: Poof! Dahyun turned into a green frog!
segs: Poof! Dahyun turned into a green frog!

lines.text: 뿅! 다현이의 볼이랑 배가 호박처럼 환해졌어요!
lines.en: Poof! Dahyun's cheeks and tummy glowed like a pumpkin!
segs: Poof! Dahyun's cheeks and tummy glowed like a pumpkin!

lines.text: 뿅! 다현이 등에 박쥐 날개가 돋았어요!
lines.en: Poof! Bat wings sprouted on Dahyun's back!
segs: Poof! Bat wings sprouted on Dahyun's back!

lines.text: 뿅! 다현이 입에 초콜릿 수염이 났어요!
lines.en: Poof! Dahyun grew a chocolate moustache!
segs: Poof! Dahyun grew a chocolate moustache!

lines.en: Rolly, rolly, roll... somebody stop me!
segs: Rolly, rolly, roll... somebody stop me!

lines.en: Quack, quack... huh? My feet!
I'm swimming in the sky!
Ribbit! Hop, all the way up to the roof!
segs: Ribbit! Hop, all the way up to the roof!

lines.en: My tummy turned into a lantern!
segs: My tummy turned into a lantern!

lines.en: Flap, flap, hello, Moon!
Drip, drip... I'm melting!
Hee hee, it's Halloween magic!
At the end, all together!

lines.text: 길을 데굴데굴 굴러가다 호박 등에 통!
lines.en: She rolled and rolled down the street and bonked into a pumpkin lantern!
segs: She rolled and rolled down the street and bonked into a pumpkin lantern!

lines.en: Waddle, waddle, and Pumpkin the cat waddled too.
segs: Waddle, waddle, and Pumpkin the cat waddled too.

lines.en: She swam, bubble bubble, all around the full moon.
segs: She swam, bubble bubble, all around the full moon.

lines.text: 폴짝, 폴짝, 폴짝! 지붕 위에서 손을 흔들었어요.
lines.en: Hop, hop, hop! She waved from up on the roof.
segs: Hop, hop, hop! She waved from up on the roof.

lines.en: The dark street grew bright, all thanks to Dahyun.
segs: The dark street grew bright, all thanks to Dahyun.

lines.text: 박쥐 친구들이랑 달 앞을 빙글 돌았어요.
lines.en: She circled in front of the moon with her bat friends.
segs: She circled in front of the moon with her bat friends.

lines.en: She went flat as a pancake... then poof!
segs: She went flat as a pancake... then poof!

lines.en: Where are you going!
She melted!
Poof! Dahyun was back to normal.
segs: Poof! Dahyun was back to normal.

lines.en: This time, shall we try a different colour?
segs: This time, shall we try a different colour?

lines.en: Tap the ingredients!

lines.text: 아까랑 같네? 다음엔 다른 색도 해 봐!
lines.en: Same as before? Next time, try a different colour too!
segs: Same as before? Next time, try a different colour too!

lines.en: Want to do it one more time?
segs: Want to do it one more time?

lines.text: 한 번 더 하려면 솥을 톡 눌러요.
lines.en: To go one more time, tap the cauldron.
segs: To go one more time, tap the cauldron.

lines.en: Whoosh, the cauldron water turned clear again.
segs: Whoosh, the cauldron water turned clear again.

lines.text: 마지막은 핼러윈 특별 사탕! 색을 전부 다 넣는 거야. 다 같이!
lines.en: Last of all, the special Halloween candy! We put in every single colour. All together!
segs: Last of all, the special Halloween candy! We put in every single colour. All together!

lines.en: Every single one?

lines.text: 이번엔 빨강, 노랑, 파랑, 초록 다 넣어요! 톡 눌러요.
lines.en: This time, put in red, yellow, blue and green, all of them! Tap!
segs: This time, put in red, yellow, blue and green, all of them! Tap!

lines.text: 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷! 색을 전부 섞으면…
lines.en: One, two, three, four! When you mix all the colours...
segs: One, two, three, four! When you mix all the colours...

lines.en: Bubble, bubble... POP!
Out came a black candy!
Huh? My lips turned black! It's ghost candy!
segs: Huh? My lips turned black! It's ghost candy!

lines.en: Hee hee, me too!
The witch, Pumpkin the cat and the friends, all with black lips...
segs: The witch, Pumpkin the cat and the friends, all with black lips...

lines.text: 유령 흉내를 내며 마을을 한 바퀴 돌았어요. 하나도 안 무서워요, 다 웃고 있거든요.
lines.en: They marched around the village pretending to be ghosts. Not scary at all, because everyone was laughing.
segs: They marched around the village pretending to be ghosts. Not scary at all, because everyone was laughing.

lines.text: 자, 약속! 남은 사탕 다 나와라!
lines.en: Now, as promised! All the leftover candy, come on out!
segs: Now, as promised! All the leftover candy, come on out!

lines.text: 솥에서 사탕이 퐁퐁퐁 쏟아졌어요. 모두 하나씩… 마녀는 두 개!
lines.en: Candy came pouring out of the cauldron, pop, pop, pop. One for everyone... and two for the witch!
segs: Candy came pouring out of the cauldron, pop, pop, pop. One for everyone... and two for the witch!

lines.en: Hee hee, two for me!

lines.text: 뿅, 뿅, 뿅! 딸기, 개구리, 오리, 박쥐, 물고기, 호박… 다 같이 변신!
lines.en: Poof, poof, poof! Strawberry, frog, duck, bat, fish, pumpkin... everyone changed together!
segs: Poof, poof, poof! Strawberry, frog, duck, bat, fish, pumpkin... everyone changed together!

lines.en: Poof! Everyone back to normal.

lines.text: 다현이 덕분에 사탕이 가득! 내년에도 같이 섞자.
lines.en: Thanks to Dahyun, we have candy galore! Let's mix again next year.
segs: Thanks to Dahyun, we have candy galore! Let's mix again next year.

lines.en: Yes! Next time, with different colours!
segs: Yes! Next time, with different colours!

lines.en: Tap the Candy Witch to say goodbye.
segs: Tap the Candy Witch to say goodbye.

ch_wantto: I want to do it too!
I want to do it too!
I want to do it too!

chorus.ch_wantto: I want to do it too!

ui.다음엔 다른 색을 섞어 볼까요?: Next time, shall we mix different colours?
